def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the sparse foreground color as zero and the background as foreground.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    foreground = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    background = next(v for v in counts if v != foreground)
    return [[background if v == foreground else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
